summary: The signed 32-bit source domain contains at most ten decimal digits, so the complete legal workload is too tightly bounded for an honest runtime-scaling verdict over digit count.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The source contract restricts x to the signed 32-bit interval from -2^31 through 2^31 - 1.

replacement_checks.evidence: Each loop iteration removes one base-10 digit, so the current solution performs at most ten digit transfers and uses constant auxiliary state.
An independent string-reversal oracle covers every authored case, all values from -10,000 through 10,000, and dense ranges at both signed 32-bit boundaries.
